name: clicloud-x402
description: Every CLI tool through a local MCP server, including x402 USDC payments from an agent wallet you fund, capped by a spending limit you set.

api_key.title: CLI API key
api_key.description: Make one in the CLI dashboard: open your project, then Connect an agent. It has its own role and spending cap.

agent_wallet_key.title: Agent wallet private key (optional)
agent_wallet_key.description: An EVM wallet (0x hex) the agent pays from over x402. Use a wallet that only holds what you're willing for the agent to spend. Leave empty to never pay.

spend_limit_usdc.title: x402 spending limit (USDC)
spend_limit_usdc.description: The most this server may pay over x402 per session. 0 never pays.
